> Avoid repeating the return type from the declaration; use a braced initializer list instead [modernize-return-braced-init-list]

Because the tip is from IDE, maybe this doesn't fit Godot's coding style.
Please turn off any IDE tools if they make it change unrelated code
Use `const` for immutable local variables. Isn’t this consistent with Godot’s coding style? Sure, I don’t force it.
But please don't change entirely unrelated code
The type required for the `set_project_metadata` parameter is Variant, `(int)` is a redundant C-style cast
But it's not related at all to this PR and removes clarity, please restore
OK, maybe these are the scope of separate PR.
As I said they aren't necessary and reduce readability so please just let them be
I just discovered that these modifications belong to the front PR #117970. That PR made some style corrections specifically for `editor_quick_open_dialog.cpp`, is this not allowed either?
